class.name: FellowSnowTracker3D
class.brief_description: Presses tracks into the snow: a foot, a wheel, a sledge's runner (FellowEngine).
class.description: While it touches the scene's top — within [member contact_height] of it, the top as the snow sees it (the active [FellowRain3D]'s shelter heightfield, wires and lamps overhead ignored) — the tracker presses a capsule of [member radius] into the snow each frame, from where it was to where it is, lengthened by [member length] along its forward axis (-Z): a footprint when it stands (a foot: [member radius] 0.055 m, [member length] 0.15 m — 26 cm with its round ends), a groove when it moves (a wheel: [member length] 0). Attach one to each foot of a character (a [BoneAttachment3D]) or each wheel of a vehicle; its origin is its lowest point. The tracks show where the active [FellowRain3D] has a snow cover with [member FellowRain3D.tracks] on. Decision record [code]docs/decisions/0130-snow-tracks.md[/code].

members.member: How far above (or below) the scene's top the tracker still presses, in metres.
How deep it presses, in metres (negative: 0.8 of [member FellowRain3D.snow_depth]; deeper than the snow shows the ground).
How far its capsule reaches along its forward axis, in metres (a foot's length less its width).
